canonical_range.range: R_can=ran(T_PB) with retained full radial/source response
canonical_range.recovery: P_rho restricted to R_can is injective and has the declared continuous inverse on its image

canonical_projector.formula: Pi_can=T_PB (P_rho T_PB)^(-1) P_rho on responses whose radial coordinate lies in ran(P_rho T_PB)
laws: ker(Pi_can) contains the balanced endpoint-Wronskian redistribution directions
canonical_projector.joint_graph_version: when the source coordinate x is explicitly retained, Pi_can(x,b)=(x,T_PB x), which is bounded and needs no inverse of an output-only map

legacy_saturation_test.input: an independently exposed U_G4^old:P_pair->B_full with the same radial projection
legacy_saturation_test.then: same radial projection plus S_old=0 implies U_G4^old=T_PB

balanced_kernel_relation.fixed_faces: same radial and Stokes faces force ran(U_G4^old-T_PB) subset N_bal
balanced_kernel_relation.projector_test: S_old extracts precisely the component not reconstructed by canonical source-range recovery
balanced_kernel_relation.rigidity: R_can intersect N_bal={0} converts saturation into filler uniqueness

weaker_evans_test.condition: S_old^top e_Ev belongs to tau O(U_ar)
weaker_evans_test.meaning: legacy filler may fail global saturation only in directions invisible on the Evans Xi-jet module

what_is_now_explicit: The missing range theorem is one projector-defect equation, not an existential statement about fillers.
missing_input: No repository record exposes the independent legacy U_G4^old or its full-response radial projection, so S_old cannot yet be evaluated.
hostile: Any nonzero (I-Pi_can)U_G4^old generator image is a concrete failure of source-range saturation even if all scalar Stokes readouts agree.
disposition: Filler rigidity has an explicit analytic witness: the canonical source-recovery projector Pi_can. Proving the old-to-new transition reduces to showing its transverse projector defect vanishes, globally or modulo Xi on Evans. The formula is complete; only the legacy forward map remains absent.
